snippet.title: Meander Demo Announcement Trailer!!
snippet.description:
From random squiggles to silly creatures, doodle anything in this cozy crochet-inspired drawing game. Save your drawings in your scrapbook and decorate them with stickers and notes. Meander lets you relax and unwind, and create fun art while you're doing it. (100% AI-free)

Wishlist on Steam or try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4714860/Meander/
